in_marathi.name: Jamirul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gem of the earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jamirul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jamirul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jamini', which means 'gem of the earth'. This name is believed to be associated with the earth element and carries the blessings of the earth goddess. In Hindu mythology, the earth is considered the mother of all beings and is revered as a source of nourishment and protection.
